name: Kiyosumi-Shirakawa
tagline: Tokyo's coffee neighborhood, with no-transfer rides to Shibuya and Otemachi.
summary: The Hanzomon Line reaches Otemachi in 10 minutes and Shibuya in 25, while the Oedo Line runs direct to Roppongi and Shinjuku. After Blue Bottle opened its first Japanese location here, independent roasters clustered in, and the café density is now among the highest in Tokyo. The Museum of Contemporary Art Tokyo and Kiyosumi Garden are both nearby.
goodFor: People who spend a lot of time in cafés
People who may commute toward either Shibuya or Otemachi
People who want old Tokyo plus cultural venues
notFor: People who want a lot of shopping options
People for whom quiet is the top priority
residentComment: It is famous for coffee, but what you notice living here is how well the two lines work together. The mix of converted warehouses and galleries makes the streetscape unlike most of Tokyo.
